content:
Hana (Docs): Quick sync-- we need a short, customer-facing migration note for the upcoming v1->v2 SDK change (streaming shape + embed dims). Keep it friendly and link to rollback steps.
Owen (SDK): I'll add a clear code map and a tiny compat shim for the top 3 callsites.
Priya (DevEx): samples need to live in samples/compat and have smoke tests that assert streaming deltas and embed length.
Ben (Product): call out billing blip: batching default changes may alter per-call costs. Clara, ok to add a support KB?
Clara (Support): yes. we'll prep canned replies and a troubleshooting checklist (ALIAS_NOT_FOUND, MODEL_ALIAS_DEPRECATED, DIM_MISMATCH).
Owen (SDK): example snippets to use in doc: 
```py
# v1 -> v2 sync
resp = client.generate(model='redwood-legacy', input='hi')
# v2
resp = client.responses.create(model='redwood-2.0', input='hi')
```
```js
// v1 streaming -> v2 streaming
for await (const e of client.responses.stream({ model: 'redwood-2.0' })) {
  if (e.type === 'delta') process.stdout.write(e.delta)
}
```
Hana (Docs): I'll draft the notice: short paragraph, link to migration guide, quick rollback steps, and a note on reindexing when embed dims change. Priya, mark samples PR as required for merge.
ci-bot: CI will run linkcheck + snippet-run + smoke-test on branch migration/quick-sdk.
Priya (DevEx): will open samples PR and include test fixtures asserting expected embed dim lengths.
Hana (Docs): owners: Hana (notice), Owen (SDK shim + README), Priya (samples + tests), Clara (support KB). Target: merge in 48h, public notice on merge.
Clara (Support): scheduling a 30m dry run with Support after merge to review canned replies.
Hana (Docs): perfect, thanks everyone. I'll post the draft in #docs-review in 1hr.
